caption:
In our PC rig the pedals cost more than the wheel base, on purpose: a 9 Nm Moza R9 base at about $329, and Moza CRP2 pedals with a 200 kg load-cell brake at about $369. The whole rig is $2,234, your PC not included. Prices are our estimates. We earn from qualifying purchases. #simracing #pcgaming

Papaya Sprint, part by part: https://roomracer.com/rigs/papaya-sprint?src=yt-answer
title: Why the pedals in this PC sim rig cost more than the wheel base
